output.brief: Store 14's shrink rise is not yet proven to be real. The figures are interim estimates from partial cycle counts, with an error margin of about ±0.6 points per quarter. Across the chain, about half of the two-quarter rises of this size were not confirmed by the year-end full count. Store 14's full-count shrink was 1.5–1.8% in the past three years. The recorded shoplifting increase is unreliable as a signal, because the incident app launched chain-wide on 1 April and recorded incidents rose across the chain while chain shrink stayed flat. The ethics-line tip was checked against CCTV and not substantiated. The sales mix did not change, so it does not explain the rise. Nothing yet separates self-checkout, customer theft and staff theft as causes, and the evidence doesn't isolate any of them. I am fairly confident in this, not certain. Next: keep store 14 in the 7 December full count and do not drop it. Hold off on a guard, on pulling or staffing the lanes, and on any action against the stocker until the count result is compared with the interim figures. Doubling cycle counts adds little. If the count confirms the rise, investigate by product category and compare with the neighbouring stores.
